regime_context: The detector shows a leader (Diversified Miners) that is NOT trend-eligible, with the eligible Conglomerates & Exchange theme holding the highest score among gated themes and the strongest durability (0.78). Rotation breadth is narrowing and absorption is moderate (0.48) with no one-narrative condition — a dispersed, non-conviction tape. Despite a 7/7 hit track record, the small sample forces low conviction; the only validated edge is drawdown control via the trend gate, which is currently keeping miners/materials OUT despite their momentum lead.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Diversified Miners becomes trend-eligible while retaining rank 1 — if it does, the prior gated avoidance of the momentum leader becomes stale and the leadership read would flip toward the miners.
